rows.grounds: fused form snānapānāt + iti; sandhi t + i yields ti

items.question: What water grants unmatched good fortune when used for bathing and drinking?
premises: Bathing and drinking bring unmatched good fortune.
The water has a circle thrown in its middle.
items.inference: The verse identifies water with a circle thrown in its middle as the means for bathing and drinking that yields unmatched good fortune.
uncertainties: The exact ritual circle and its placement are not specified.
items.plain_english: Thus, by bathing and drinking the water in which a circle has been thrown in the middle.
